<!-- main-issue123-active-issue518-complete-20260918 -->
Issue [#518 is completed](https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/issues/518#issuecomment-5720269209).
The helper supplement compared the original target and relevant definitions
against main. The statement body matches byte-for-byte under the explicit
`tildeM_consistent_pointMeas_ofGlobalPairWitness` name; no hypothesis,
quantifier or conclusion changed.

MAIN resolved the supplement's cache-check caveat before closure. The retired
review worktree was rewarmed from complete `c68d3e9b`; the no-build check for
Extraction.Construction passed with all9231 targets up to date, then the
original-statement probe elaborated successfully. All seven queried closures
contain only the three standard axioms. All source/toolchain inputs match
published-main `c99409c7`, eight artifact hashes were checked, and no open
sub-issue exists. Evidence and the earlier diagnostic are archived in
`owner-audits/supersession-20260917/issue518-completion.jsonl`. This closes the
named supplied-witness proof packet, not parent #123 or final soundness.

The sole native is now Sol/Ultra Boole
(`01a0b0e3-04c0-7ea1-82b5-339e966a1653`), working on #123's missing source-facing
unitary-extraction composition. Both producer theorems are proved on main;
the conditional proof packet #523 is closed. The exact unqualified theorem
name is absent from primary, all worktrees and the supersession reports.
The new worktree is based on published `4cfa7332`, warmed from complete
`c68d3e9b` and hook-checked. Atomic main-fix123 reserves this issue/declaration;
it is not an operation on historical PR123.

The task must derive the global witness internally and retain both players,
normalized auxiliary state and exact error/domain conditions. A paper and
carrier comparison plus fresh axioms are mandatory before any source-node
completion mark; an unresolved domain obstruction must be reported explicitly.
No final-soundness change or new attempt at the closed producer proofs is
authorized. Start19:41:03.134Z; budget900s/deadline19:56:03.134Z with the last180s
reserved for checks and receipt. Admission, actual initial task delta, model,
effort, rollout and brief are in
`native-audits/issue123-source-unitary-01a0b0e3/admission.jsonl`.

#456's model-free update stopped on six conflicts and restored clean `e8a69238`.
The Opus content fixer claimed it at19:33:06Z. Existing main proofs, current
resampling API, source-domain distinctions and all four prior full reviews
must be preserved; a changed patch gets a bounded terminal disposition after
normal gates, not a fabricated carry or automatic fifth full-review loop.
#299 and #481 remain next in merge order.

The preserved #543 packet is now PR #580 (`4bd78e34`) and #539's doc correction
is PR #581 (`8eaebbe3`), both reported CI-green. Spare fresh Opus reviewers may
assess these while #456 has no ready head, without delaying the critical queue.
MAIN holds their review-status/merge sequencing until the priority merges.
Their original PR retirement paths remain separate from publication alone.

The snapshot completed; the previous cycle is progress (#467 merged). Caps0/0/0,
one native, no lanes, daemon-only merges and no #168 post. The full goal remains active.
